_note: REAL Lighthouse 13.4.0 capture (live run, 2026-07-25) — trimmed to the fields src/lighthouse.ts's LighthouseResult reads. Captured by serving a blank static page (no painted content) and running lighthouse-node against it with chrome-launcher, headless Chrome, onlyCategories:['performance'] — the same invocation src/cli/lighthouse-scan.ts uses. This is the NO_FCP failure mode #488/#556 already document: Lighthouse's core/scoring.js nulls categories.performance.score whenever ANY weighted performance audit (LCP weight 25, TBT weight 30, CLS weight 25 — confirmed from this same capture's categories.performance.auditRefs) has scoreDisplayMode 'error', so a page this broken already fails src/lighthouse.ts's lighthouseRunErrorReason (categories.performance.score == null) and never reaches parseLighthouseFindings via the shipped CLI. It is committed here anyway because it is the only REAL capture available of the scoreDisplayMode:'error'/errorMessage audit shape (#1074 requires a captured, not hand-written, fixture for that shape) — src/lighthouse.test.ts uses it to unit-test metricNotMeasuredFinding's own logic directly (bypassing the CLI's upstream guard), since that function must not silently read an errored audit as a clean pass regardless of whether today's single call site happens to filter the case out first.
